'''Mick''' was a [[INS-444]] that worked with the [[CLE-004 window cleaning droid]] [[Buffy]]<ref name="BuildR2 38 note" /> on the [[ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant]]. The two [[droid]]s replaced the bedroom window of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[Padmé's Apartment|apartment]] after the original window was destroyed through the actions of [[Zam Wesell]]'s [[ASN-121|assassin droid]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
As noted by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]], the window installer droid carries an [[Aurebesh]] label identifying them as "Mick"; however, it is too small to read on-screen.<ref name="Pablo Buffy and Mick tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1486918460290453504|Pablo Hidalgo|date=2022-01-28|quote=Too small to read are aurebesh labels on the droids identifying them as "Mick" (installer) and "Buffy" (cleaner).|archivedate=20220128043323}}</ref>
